meta.note: Relative influence estimates for visualization only — not precise market shares.

territories.name: Legal
territories.note: Google launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal (Preview). Harvey strong. Microsoft via Copilot + partners.

territories.name: Financial Services
territories.note: Google Gemini Enterprise for FS launched same day. Microsoft deep via Azure + Copilot.

territories.name: Healthcare
territories.note: Next on Google roadmap. Strong specialist presence. Microsoft Copilot adoption high.

territories.name: Life Sciences
territories.note: Explicitly on Google horizon. High governance needs favor controlled platforms.

territories.name: Insurance
territories.note: Microsoft strong via existing enterprise footprint.

territories.name: Government
territories.note: Long cycles, high trust. Microsoft & IBM historically strong.

territories.name: Retail
territories.note: Listed as coming soon by Google for Gemini Enterprise industry solutions.

na.note: Microsoft Copilot + Azure strongest in North American enterprises. Google rising fast with Legal/FS launches.

sa.note: Microsoft still leads; lower overall enterprise AI maturity.

eu.note: Strong Microsoft footprint. Google gaining with regulated focus. Anthropic in safety-sensitive deals.

af.note: Emerging. Microsoft and Google competing for public sector and banking.

as.note: Google Cloud strong in APAC. Microsoft and AWS also major.

oc.note: Microsoft dominant in Australia/NZ. Google increasing presence.

events.text: Google launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal + Financial Services. Roadmap: Healthcare, Life Sciences, Retail.
Menlo Ventures (late 2025): Anthropic ~40% enterprise LLM spend, OpenAI ~27%, Google ~21%.
Microsoft continues strong horizontal distribution via M365 Copilot in regulated industries.
